contract: POST /api/podcasts/opml/parse is admin-only and answers {feeds: [{title, feedUrl}]} for every outline of the posted OPML text whose type attribute is exactly rss and that has an xmlUrl; the title is the outline title attribute, falling back to text, and then to the empty string. Nested outlines are reported in document order; other outline types, an upper-case type and an outline without xmlUrl are skipped. A missing or empty opmlText answers 400.
evidence: go-backend/testmachine/scenarios/podcast_feed: the four OPML preview scenarios pass against pinned upstream in two consecutive full packet runs
exceptions: force is not applicable: the OPML preview has no force/override parameter.

invariants.contract: POST /api/podcasts/opml/parse answers 401 without a token, 403 for a non-admin and 400 when opmlText is missing or empty; a rejected request creates no rows.

An accepted request answers feeds in document order: each rss outline yields its xmlUrl and its title attribute or text attribute (empty when neither is set); an outline of another type, an outline whose type is not lower-case rss and an rss outline without xmlUrl are skipped, and an OPML document with no outlines answers an empty array. Two identical requests answer identical feeds and create no rows.
